comment: Frozen gaps for scripts/check-course-visuals.mjs (Course Standard v1 section 4.1 items 1-3, Linear GP-752), taken on origin/main 9f709922, 21/11/2026.
Each entry is a known missing cover, lesson image or diagram, keyed by course slug, lesson id and kind; it covers that lesson in the seed catalogue and in its v1-draft copy.

This file only shrinks: when you add the missing visual, delete its entry in the same change (the check fails until you do). Adding an entry needs the founder's or lead's written approval in that PR; it is never a quiet way to let a new lesson through.

GP-772 (22/11/2026): 24 entries for assessing-indoor-environment-conditions (12 lesson images, 12 diagrams) in its GP-468 v1-draft, added with the founder's written approval on GP-772. Each entry is deleted when its visual lands (GP-468); the visuals stay required before that course is published.

GP-471 (23/11/2026): 26 entries for psychrometry-building-science-for-drying (13 lesson images, 13 diagrams) in its GP-471 v1-draft, added with the founder's written approval on GP-471 (Linear comment 5dabb8e6). Each entry is deleted when its visual lands; the visuals stay required before that course is published.
